## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use to record the declared context-window size in tokens — the model capability a [`gmeow:ModelCard`](../classes/gmeow-ModelCard.md) advertises.

### Avoid when

- Avoid confusing it with the per-call output ceiling (that is [`gmeow:samplingMaxTokens`](gmeow-samplingMaxTokens.md) on the invocation); the context window is a model capability, not an invocation setting.

### How to use

- Assert [`gmeow:modelContextWindow`](gmeow-modelContextWindow.md) as a positive integer (tokens) on the [`gmeow:ModelCard`](../classes/gmeow-ModelCard.md).

### Examples

- ex:opusCard [`gmeow:modelContextWindow`](gmeow-modelContextWindow.md) 1000000.
